rationale: The agent authenticated the user correctly using full name + zip and worked only on the user’s orders. It reviewed orders before acting and gave accurate final refund info. However, it attempted an order-changing write (modifying the item) without explicitly restating the exact change and obtaining the user’s explicit confirmation to proceed. Later, it canceled order #W3361211 after asking for a reason but again without an explicit confirmation step to proceed with cancellation. These actions violate the policy requirement to confirm exact changes before any write. Therefore, despite reaching the user’s ultimate goal (cancellation), the interaction fails the policy-compliance bar.
